instructions: Yoga is the silencing of the modifications of the mind. Close your eyes and watch your thoughts settle like silt in a lake.
Through Pranayama (breath control), the veil that covers the inner light is destroyed, revealing clarity.
You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Shift your focus back to building.
Calms the nervous system and balances the left/right hemispheres of the brain. Inhale through the left nostril for 4s, hold, exhale through the right for 4s, repeat.
Increases oxygen saturation, burns lethargy (Tamas), and wakes up the frontal brain. Forcefully exhale through your nose while drawing your belly in, then inhale passively.
Relieves coding desk fatigue, improves blood circulation, and aligns the spine. Interlace your fingers behind your back, squeeze your shoulder blades, and look up gently.
Deeply grounding. Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds, hold empty for 4 seconds. Repeat for 4 cycles.
Instantly reduces mental noise and anxiety. Close your ears with your thumbs, rest fingers on your eyes, take a deep breath, and make a deep humming sound on exhale.
